visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A muscular man wearing a black 'TEAM JOINED' t-shirt and a black baseball cap is positioned on an incline weight bench. He has extensive tattoos on his left forearm. He initially holds a silver barbell over his chest. The gym background features black weight plates on racks and bright studio-style overhead lighting. No text is yet visible on the screen. (2) As the man begins the pressing motion, he removes his hands entirely from the barbell, which stays suspended. He makes a comical facial expression with pursed lips. The barbell is silver with black ends. Yellow and white text appears at the bottom. The background remains the same gym setting with equipment. (3) A woman wearing a black cap and jacket is revealed to be standing behind the man, gripping and moving the barbell for him. The man continues to mimic the lifting motion with his empty hands while smiling at the camera. Question marks appear as variety text overlays above the woman's head. The surrounding gym environment is visible through the mirror.
